items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage at the labour court
items.quote: Zu Ihrer Information: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: The letter was personally handed over to the employee on 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), witnessed by Herr Exempelwinzer, so receipt = 18.11.2026. §4 KSchG gives 3 weeks from receipt of the written notice to file a Kündigungsschutzklage. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted, so counting starts 19.11.2026. Three weeks later is Wed 09.12.2026 (§188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). 09.12.2026 is a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday shift (§193 BGB) applies.

items.title: Register as job-seeking (arbeitsuchend) with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: The letter only says 'sofort' (immediately) without naming a number of days; the underlying statutory duty is §38 Abs. 1 SGB III. The employee learned the end date of the employment (31.01.2027) on the day of receipt, 18.11.2026 (Wed). Since less than three months lie between that day of knowledge and the end date, the duty is to register within 3 days of gaining that knowledge. Under §26 SGB X / §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (18.11.) is not counted; the 3 days run 19., 20., 21.11.2026, landing on Saturday 21.11.2026. Because the deadline falls on a non-working day it moves to the next business day under §26 Abs. 3 SGB X / §193 BGB, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026. As today is 24.11.2026, this statutory deadline has already passed.

items.title: Employment ends / notice period expires
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the ordinary termination date explicitly as 31.01.2027; this calendar date is taken as given from the letter.

warnings: The statutory 3-day deadline to register as 'arbeitsuchend' with the Agentur für Arbeit (derived from §38 SGB III, since the letter itself only says 'sofort') works out to 23.11.2026, which is already in the past as of today (24.11.2026) — if this has not been done yet, register immediately to avoid a reduction (Sperrzeit) of Arbeitslosengeld.

The Klage deadline of three weeks from receipt is a firm statutory deadline (§4 KSchG) — missing it generally means the dismissal is deemed legally effective regardless of its merits; consider contacting a union, employment lawyer or the Arbeitsgericht's Rechtsantragstelle promptly.
The exact competent Arbeitsgericht (employer's seat vs. place of work) is not stated in the letter and has not been verified here.
